title: Verification result
description: findings/<finding_id>/verify.json. Read by gate_triage_pass.py — triager cannot output PASS unless verdict here is CONFIRMED.

reproduced_from.description: Must be 'poc_steps'. Reproducing from the prior agent's reasoning instead of the written steps is not verification — it is agreement.

steps_insufficient.description: Steps that had to be guessed at or filled in. Any entry here is a defect in the PoC even if reproduction succeeded — the program will hit the same gap.

minimized_poc.description: The tightest sequence that still demonstrates the issue.

evidence_audit.description: Every artifact cited upstream, checked against actual tool-call history rather than taken on trust.

items_traced.description: How many resolved to a real tool execution in this run. Must equal items_checked minus dropped.

dropped.description: Artifacts that could not be traced. These are removed from the finding, not retained with a caveat.
